LESSON: GUIDED READING: READING FLUENCY

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ARABIC
Strand: Reading 2.1 Guided Reading : Reading Fluency (2 Sessions) • Speed • Expression •
Topic 2.4: Guided Reading: Reading Fluency
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Guided Reading: Reading Fluency, part of Reading 2.1 Guided Reading : Reading Fluency (2 Sessions) • Speed • Expression • in Grade 8 ARABIC.

Key inquiry question: How can you show love to your family members? 2. How can you tell the meaning of a new word in a text?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. conduct a reader’s theatre to read texts related to extended family members,

2. peer assess each other’s reading for fluency,

3. create a vocabulary list of new words identified from the text,

4. collaborate with peers to infer the meaning of vocabulary used from context,

5. make sentences using the vocabulary acquired,

6. take turns reading conversations about extended family members,

7. collaborate with peers to dramatise the conversations. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. conduct a reader’s theatre to read texts related to extended family members,
2. peer assess each other’s reading for fluency,
3. create a vocabulary list of new words identified from the text,
4. collaborate with peers to infer the meaning of vocabulary used from context,
5. make sentences using the vocabulary acquired,
6. take turns reading conversations about extended family members,
7. collaborate with peers to dramatise the conversations. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Guided Reading: Reading Fluency together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Creativity and Imagination: These are promoted as the learner exchanges new ideas that inspire creativity when collaborating

with peers to dramatise the conversations.

• Citizenship: This is enhanced as the learner accumulates information when conducting a reader’s theatre to read texts related

to extended family members.

23

Values:
• Integrity: This is instilled as the learner displays transparency when peer assessing each other’s reading for fluency.

• Social justice: This is enhanced as the learner accords equal opportunities to peers when conducting a reader’s theatre to

read texts related to extended family members.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Social cohesion: This is promoted as the learner interacts with texts on the extended family, their roles and appreciates the

family structure.

Link to other learning areas:

The learner is able to relate the concept on family to their learning of social structure of the society covered in Religious

Education.
